title: Hearty Roasted Brazilian Pumpkin Tart
description: A roasted and velvety Brazilian dish featuring pumpkin in a flaky crust, perfect for a low-sodium friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the pumpkin cubes with olive oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt-free seasoning, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the pumpkin mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the pumpkin is tender.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and shredded cheese.
Add the roasted pumpkin mixture to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the pumpkin and egg mixture into the pie crust.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
